subject: 地方宫室模块（原创扩展，不具名布达拉宫）
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Redraw the attached Tibetan secular palace sprite to CORRECT the ground proportions. The current long frontage is FAR too long and the depth is far too short; it must become a NEARLY SQUARE plan, frontage only 1.25 times depth (20 by16). Compress front facade width and extend the rightward-visible side wall significantly. True 2:1 ORTHOGRAPHIC dimetric camera yaw45/pitch30. Ground slopes must be +0.5 and -0.5, not shallow. Thin ground contact perimeter on1536x1024 canvas corners LEFT(208,530), FRONT(830,841), RIGHT(1328,592), BACK(706,281). Therefore front corner is only62px right of image centre. Match all wall and roof lines to those parallel axes. NO perspective convergence. Preserve Tibetan thick white stone walls with ochre red top band, flat roofs, black timber windows, moderate three-storey height, lower side wing, simple entrance steps; no golden roof. Architecture can change dimensions freely to fit corrected shape. Upper-left light. No high base. Alpha0 transparent background, no fog/halo/glow. No text/people/watermark/guidelines. At least64px clear margin.
negative: 人物、文字、伪字、经文、标牌、水印、现代材料、旅游重建外观、布达拉宫具名外观、汉式灰瓦覆盖全建筑、背景风景、浮岛、厚底座、透视汇聚、裁切、右侧主光、长阴影、伪透明棋盘格。

Clear rugged stone courses, lightly weathered white or ochre plaster, thick gently battered walls, flat earthen parapet roof, small dark timber windows with black trapezoidal surrounds and modest red-brown timber cornices. Natural warm-neutral light from SCREEN UPPER LEFT and only a small soft contact shadow to lower right. TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA background. Not a complete city scene. One coherent three-storey battered stone block with a lower attached side wing, whitewashed stone lower walls, restrained ochre-red upper band, small black-framed timber windows, broad flat earthen parapet roofs, rich but subdued timber door surround and broad short stone entry steps. Clear stone ground perimeter corners LEFT(208,560), FRONT(830.2222222222222,871.1111111111111), RIGHT(1328,622.2222222222222), BACK(705.7777777777778,311.1111111111111). These are ground contact corners. Make palace roof high but fully contained in frame. Stairs face lower-left and stay inside contact rectangle. Both ground slopes +0.5/-0.5. No monumental high platform.
rejected.reason: 第一张底面明显过长、双轴偏浅；二图有改善但仍未满足几何建议容差。
